verdict.rationale: Fedora's official docs explicitly claim easy install/update/manage of software packages and single-command tool access (fedora-docs-7, fedora-docs-8), but there is no independent/community evidence in the pack validating package manager (dnf) usability, and some community comments raise friction with Flatpak-based software installation (fedora-comm-14, fedora-comm-12), suggesting mixed real-world experience.
